tips.title: SET THE CAMERA BUTTON
tips.body: Settings → Controller. On PS5 set the Touchpad from Map to Camera. On Xbox set the View button to Camera.

tips.title: DRIVER'S SEAT + PHONE
tips.body: Sit in the driver's seat and press D-pad Up. With the phone out, the view switches to first person.

tips.title: CLOSE + SPAM CAMERA
tips.body: Close the phone with Circle / B and instantly tap Touchpad / View a few times. Timing is tight: just retry.

tips.title: NO WAY BACK
tips.body: It stays first person, even on foot. Back to normal = reload your save. Not an official mode, Rockstar may patch it.
